## Review checklist

### Evidence and scope
- [ ] This change preserves the repository's stated evidence boundary.
- [ ] New claims are labeled demonstrated, simulated, prototype, proposed, or speculative.
- [ ] Tests or documentation cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Failure cases and limitations remain visible.

### Security and ownership
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private data, or credentials are included.
- [ ] Permissions remain least-privileged.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes are reviewable by the repository owner.
- [ ] This change does not transfer or imply ownership, licensing, or publication rights.

### Reproducibility
- [ ] A reviewer can run the relevant test or validation command.
- [ ] Inputs, versions, and expected outcomes are documented.
- [ ] Generated artifacts identify their source and method.
